newsitem.title: USA: Junk issues dominate U.S. corp bond primary arena.
newsitem.headline: Junk issues dominate U.S. corp bond primary arena.

text.p: Most corporate bond new issue activity is expected to center around the high-yield sector as a backup in U.S. Treasury yields and a shortened holiday week keep high-grade issuers at bay, dealers said.

"Things are definitely winding down," said one high-grade syndicate source. "But I think people are suspecting that the window on trust preferreds is going to close soon so you'll see some of those issues come in."
While the bulk of supply will come from several high-yield private placement offerings, two issuers of capital securities are expected to tap the market, players said.
